text: じゃまだから　あっち　いけよ！

patterns.name: 〜から
patterns.explanation: から after a statement means 'because'. The reason comes first, the result after. じゃまだから = 'because you're in the way'.

patterns.name: 〜ろ (command)
patterns.explanation: This verb ending is a blunt order, rude unless said to a friend. いく becomes いけ. いけよ = 'go, will you!'
